title: Intwasahlobo Ngaphansi Kwesihlabathi
intro: Ezincwadini ze-Quran, umuntu onesineke esikhulu wabhekana novivinyo olwaluzophula izinhliziyo eziqinile. Konke kwasuswa - ingcebo, umndeni, kanye nempilo. Kodwa kusukela ekujuleni kokuphelelwa yithemba, umthandazo othobekile waphendulwa ngendlela engalindelekile. Ungawubona lo mphefumulo onendaba yokubuyiselwa ehlala izwakala iminyaka eminingi?
clues: Ngavivinywa ngovivinyo olunzima kangangokuthi luyakhunjulwa kuyo yonke iminyaka.
Ngilahlekelwe yikho konke okwakubalulekile - ingcebo yami, izingane zami, kanye nempilo yami.
Umzimba wami wawugcwele izilonda ezibuhlungu, futhi bonke babengigwema.
Ngiphelelwe yithemba, ngabiza u-Allah, ngithi uSathane ungithinte ngobunzima nokuhlushwa.
U-Allah wangiphendula futhi wangiyala ukuba ngishaye umhlaba ngonyawo lwami.
Kuleyo ndawo kanye, kwavela umthombo opholile, futhi u-Allah wabuyisela umndeni wami futhi wawuphinda kabili njengesihe.

outcome.label: Umphumela
options: Umndeni nengcebo ibuyiselwe futhi yaphindwa kabili
outcome.answer: Umndeni nengcebo ibuyiselwe futhi yaphindwa kabili

arabic: وَٱذْكُرْ عَبْدَنَآ أَيُّوبَ إِذْ نَادَىٰ رَبَّهُۥٓ أَنِّى مَسَّنِىَ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ بِنُصْبٍۢ وَعَذَابٍ
verse: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, "Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment." (38:41)
